 Atlas 2 – 5 Club América Esteves   73' (P) , Mmaee   78' Borja   26' , Sánchez   28' , Rodríguez   58' , Zendejas   63' , Álvarez   79' FULL TIME Goals and highlights from Atlas 2-5 América in Liga MX
 A great match took place in Guadalajara; both teams gave it their all, and for now, América remains the leader of the competition after a 2–5 victory.
 Coverage by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma Updated October 21, 2026, 11:30 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 11:30 PM ET 90+7' 11:03 PM ET 43 minutes ago Match ends
 The match concludes, and América secures another three points in this Matchday 10 of Liga MX after a dominant performance. Hopefully, they continue to give their best throughout the competition.
 See you soon! Thank you for joining us—we look forward to having you back. Stay tuned to VAVEL for the best coverage of your favorite teams.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 Key moments
 11:03 PM ET 90+7' Match ends 
 10:56 PM ET 79' Goal by Kevin Álvarez · 2-5 
 10:54 PM ET 78' Goal by Ryan Mmaee · 2-4 
 10:44 PM ET 73' Goal by Luís André Leite Esteves · 1-4 
 10:39 PM ET 63' Goal by Álex Zendejas · 0-4 
 10:23 PM ET 58' Goal by Brian Rodríguez · 0-3 
 10:07 PM ET 46' The second half begins 
 9:39 PM ET 36' Half-time 
 9:34 PM ET 28' Goal by Érick Sánchez · 0-2 
 9:32 PM ET 26' Goal by Miguel Borja · 0-1 
 9:28 PM ET 24' Yellow card 
 9:03 PM ET 1' The game begins 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 90+4' 11:01 PM ET an hour ago América continues to look for another opportunity; a moment ago, Óscar Perea tried his luck with a left-footed shot from the left side of the penalty area, but he missed. Hopefully, they will gradually create more goal-scoring chances as this match nears its end.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 90' 10:59 PM ET an hour ago Seven more minutes are added; considering all the moments when a little time was lost, the referee decided to add a few more minutes of stoppage time, which will make for a thrilling finish to the game for both teams, who are eager to come away with the win in this great match.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 86' 10:59 PM ET an hour ago There are only four minutes left in the game, and both teams are still looking for one more chance, but fouls continue to be a constant. Let's hope that, little by little, both teams give it their all to score.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 82' 10:57 PM ET an hour ago There are less than ten minutes left in the game, and the home team doesn't want to drop any points, but just a moment ago Isaías Violante took a shot with his left foot from the center of the box, but it went just wide.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 79' 10:56 PM ET an hour ago Americas' GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAL
 América has now scored their fifth goal—this match is absolutely wild! In the 79th minute, Kevin Álvarez struck a powerful right-footed shot from very close range on the right side of the goal, bringing the score to 2–5 in favor of "Las Águilas."
 ¡Pero qué golazo de Kevin Álvarez! 🔥👏
El lateral del @ClubAmerica la prendió, la mandó al poste y para adentro. ¡Manita del Ave! 🦅🖐️
#LaLigaDeLaAfición | #AP26 | #J13 | #ATSAME https://t.co/vpJH1845f8
— Liga BBVA MX (@LigaBBVAMX) October 22, 2026 
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 78' 10:54 PM ET an hour ago Atlas' GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAL
 Atlas has already scored their second goal: in the 78th minute, Ryan Mmaee fired a great right-footed shot from outside the box to the right side of the goal, following a great assist from Sergio Hernandez, and with that, they now have a better chance of tying the game.
 ¡La 🎱 a la esquina! 🔥👏
Ryan Maee pone el segundo del @AtlasFC para acercar a los Zorros. 🦊
#LaLigaDeLaAfición | #AP26 | #J13 | #ATSAME https://t.co/ycfsSlquh8
— Liga BBVA MX (@LigaBBVAMX) October 22, 2026 
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 73' 10:44 PM ET an hour ago Atlas' GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAL
 Atlas have already scored the first goal, as after being awarded a penalty, Luis Esteves converted it with a right-footed shot into the top right corner, and with that they can now look to achieve a better result in
 ¡Los Rojinegros descuentan! 🔥
Luís Esteves anota desde los 11 pasos para el @AtlasFC. 🦊
#LaLigaDeLaAfición | #AP26 | #J13 | #ATSAME https://t.co/bUqwHlNacR
— Liga BBVA MX (@LigaBBVAMX) October 22, 2026 
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 70' 10:42 PM ET an hour ago There are only twenty minutes left in the match, and the home side is still looking for an opportunity; a moment ago, Luis Esteves tried his luck with a right-footed shot from outside the box, but he missed. At this very moment, Atlas has been awarded a penalty.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 66' 10:40 PM ET an hour ago Following the goal, the match remained so intense that play had to be briefly halted due to an injury to Alejandro Zendejas; we hope the player recovers and performs at his best, so he can find better form during this period.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 63' 10:39 PM ET an hour ago Americas' GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAL
 América has already scored their fourth goal: in the 63rd minute, Alejandro Zendejas fired a great left-footed shot from the center of the box into the left corner, extending the Águilas' lead and making it even harder for the Rojinegros to mount a comeback.
 ¡Goleada de las Águilas en el Jalisco! 🔥
Alejandro Zendejas se suma a la fiesta y anota para el @ClubAmerica. 🦅|
#LaLigaDeLaAfición | #AP26 | #J13 | #ATSAME https://t.co/YMoSkTJsK4
— Liga BBVA MX (@LigaBBVAMX) October 22, 2026 
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 62' 10:25 PM ET an hour ago We're now at the 60-minute mark of the game, and the visiting team is leading 0-3. So far, the fouls have been very intense; let's hope this doesn't affect the pace of the game. Both teams are still pushing to score more goals.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 58' 10:23 PM ET an hour ago Americas' GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAL
 The visitors have already scored their third goal, and just a moment ago, in the 58th minute, Brian Rodríguez fired a great right-footed shot from outside the box right down the middle of the goal, thanks to a great assist from Alejandro Zendejas following a counterattack—the score is now 0-3 in favor of the Águilas.
 ⏱️ 58’ | ¡Goooooooooooool! ⚽️ ¡Contragolpe LETAL! ⚡
Brian Rodríguez puso la velocidad y las redes de Atlas terminaron por sacudirse. 💥⚽
@AtlasFC 0-3 @ClubAmerica | 🦊🆚🦅
#LaLigaDeLaAfición | #AP26 | #J13 | #ATSAME https://t.co/cOIsPEDxen
— Liga BBVA MX (@LigaBBVAMX) October 22, 2026 
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 58' 10:21 PM ET an hour ago We're almost at the 60-minute mark of the game, and just a moment ago Miguel Borja took a shot with his right foot from the left side of the penalty area, but it went wide. Let's hope to see more scoring chances.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 54' 10:16 PM ET 2 hours ago Right now, Atlas is still looking for more chances to tie the game, and just a moment ago, Ryan Mmaee tried a right-footed shot from the center of the box, but it went wide. The Rojinegros are looking much better.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 50' 10:13 PM ET 2 hours ago In the opening minutes of the second half, the game got off to a very intense start; both teams continue to do their best to create scoring opportunities. Let's hope we see more scoring chances as the game goes on.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 46' 10:07 PM ET 2 hours ago The second half begins
 The ball is rolling again on the field for the next 45 minutes of the Atlas vs. América match; key substitutions are already being made, and let’s hope for a better game, that the goals keep coming, and that one of these teams comes away with the win in this great match.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 45+2' 9:51 PM ET 2 hours ago The first half ends
 The first half of the game has come to a close, with both teams giving it their all; the match remained very tight, and América managed to open the scoring, so we head into halftime with a score of 0-2—we’re witnessing a great game
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 45' 9:48 PM ET 2 hours ago Two minutes are added; the referee decided to grant a few extra minutes of stoppage time following the recent plays, since the clock had run out, and here are the highlights from those final minutes of the first half.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 40' 9:43 PM ET 2 hours ago There are only five minutes left in the first half, and just a moment ago, Elías Montiel took a right-footed shot from outside the box, but it went wide. Let's hope the home team can score a goal......
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 36' 9:39 PM ET 2 hours ago We're almost at the end of the first half—there are less than ten minutes left—and América continues to dominate the field. Despite that, Atlas is giving it their all, and just a moment ago Arturo González took a left-footed shot from the center of the box, but it was saved.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 32' 9:36 PM ET 2 hours ago The Eagles are still looking to score another goal; since their first goal, they've been more motivated, and just a moment ago, Brian Rodríguez attempted a through ball, but Miguel Borja was offside...
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 28' 9:34 PM ET 2 hours ago Americas' GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAL
 The visitors have already scored their second goal, and in the 28th minute, Érick Sánchez fired a great left-footed shot from the left side of the penalty area toward the center of the goal, assisted by Carlos Álvarez; the Águilas have extended their lead in just a few minutes.
 ¡El @ClubAmerica en modo aplanadora! 😱
Erick Sánchez se hace presente y pone el segundo para las Águilas apenas unos minutos después. 👏🦅
#LaLigaDeLaAfición | #AP26 | #J13 | #ATSAME https://t.co/M8JW5t3Lxj
— Liga BBVA MX (@LigaBBVAMX) October 22, 2026 
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 26' 9:32 PM ET 2 hours ago Americas' GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAAL
 The scoring has already begun, and the visiting team is already ahead in the 26th minute, as Miguel Borja fired a great right-footed shot from the center of the box into the right side of the goal off a great assist from Brian Rodríguez; the Eagles are now in the lead.
 ¡Pero qué golazo del @ClubAmerica! 🦅
Una locura la recepción de Brian Rodríguez y Borja la empuja para el primero del Ave. 👏
#LaLigaDeLaAfición | #AP26 | #J13 | #ATSAME https://t.co/uQdjpSn6Mi
— Liga BBVA MX (@LigaBBVAMX) October 22, 2026 
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 24' 9:28 PM ET 2 hours ago The game is getting more and more intense—the first yellow card has already been issued—and in the 22nd minute, Franco Rossano received a yellow card for dangerous play. Let's hope Ramos Palazuelos can calm things down and that we'll see a goal soon.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 20' 9:25 PM ET 2 hours ago We're past the first twenty minutes of the game and the score is still 0-0. Both teams are looking to break the deadlock, but their chances are falling short. Just a moment ago, Juan Purata tried a header from the center of the box, very close to the left post, but it went slightly wide.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 16' 9:19 PM ET 2 hours ago We're past the first fifteen minutes of the game, and just a moment ago Franco Rossano tried a header from the center of the box after a free kick was taken, but it went over the crossbar and the play didn't result in a goal. Both teams are eager to open the scoring.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 12' 9:16 PM ET 3 hours ago We're already past the first ten minutes of the game, and both teams are committing a lot of fouls so far, which is marring the game a bit. Let's hope they can create a scoring opportunity soon so we can see more action.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 8' 9:12 PM ET 3 hours ago We're almost 10 minutes into the game, and both teams are still looking for a key scoring opportunity. So far, Atlas has had the better chances; América is gradually gaining possession, but hasn't been able to convert.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 4' 9:10 PM ET 3 hours ago It's the opening minutes of the first half, and the home team is controlling the ball right now. They just took a shot, but it went wide of the goal. The home team continues to look for more scoring opportunities soon.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 1' 9:03 PM ET 3 hours ago The game begins
 The match is underway; the ball is already rolling on the field, and the home team kicked off to gain possession right from the start. Both teams are looking for the win and to score goals, and they’ll give it their all to achieve that and gain the upper hand in these opening minutes.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 8:58 PM ET 3 hours ago Stay tuned
 Everything is almost ready at the stadium to follow the broadcast on VAVEL.com, with every development on the field and the final score of the Liga MX Matchday 10 game, as they aim to earn three more points.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 8:56 PM ET 3 hours ago Follow Atlas. vs America Live Score with VAVEL!
 We'll share the starting lineups for the match, along with the latest updates from Jalisco Stadium, without missing a single detail from the match updates and commentary from VAVEL's coverage.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 8:48 PM ET 3 hours ago How can I watch the Atlas vs. América game live?
 The Atlas vs. América game will not be broadcast on television
 The Atlas vs. América game will be broadcast on: TUDN USA, TUDN.com, the TUDN app, and ViX
 If you want to watch it online, VAVEL is the best option
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 8:46 PM ET 3 hours ago They're already checking out the field
 The players are almost ready to train ahead of the match and are checking out the field; both teams will give it their all to win this Liga MX Matchday 10 clash, get off on the right foot this matchday, and secure a victory
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 8:42 PM ET 3 hours ago Fans are already arriving
 Fans are already arriving for this big matchup on Matchday 10 of Liga MX, where both teams will give it their all and look to secure the win; it won’t be long before the match begins and both teams give their best to earn points in this game.
 Updates by Fernanda Gamboa Ledesma
 8:38 PM ET 3 hours ago América is arriving at the stadium
 The América players are arriving at the stadium; they’ll be giving it their all to secure a win in this Matchday 10 game, thereby solidifying their victory and, in doing so, aiming to improve their record, build momentum, and continue performing well in this competition
